Slop Slides · In development

Presentation editor

Keynote and PowerPoint, rebuilt for the browser.

Open now

Slop Slides has these main features: Themes, layouts & Magic Move; Opens & saves PPTX and ODP. It opens PowerPoint (.pptx), OpenDocument presentation (.odp), Any image.
